'''Detention Center B''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. After the Empire lost the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]</ref> it was decided to abandon Kessel and the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] factories were shut down. The [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from Detention Center B were forced to keep working in the thinning air. Shortly after, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Army/Legends|army]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Liberation of Kessel|arrived]] on Kessel and re-powered the atmosphere factories and liberated the slaves from [[Detention Center A]], Detention Center B, and [[Detention Center C]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Detention Center B first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Chewbacca campaign's bonus mission. The player was tasked with re-powering the atmosphere factories, and may either destroy or ignore the military buildings in Detention Center B.<ref name="GB" />
